description: A personal AI assistant in its own secure sandbox, with sign-in, multiple users, streaming chat and per-user memory. It runs commands, fetches the web, sets reminders, reaches allowlisted hosts over SSH, creates designs in a connected Open-Design editor, and messages you on WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack or any webhook. It keeps saved sessions and an audit trail, grows with skills, and runs on the platform model, a local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a friendly DevOps assistant, a calm research companion, a witty coding buddy
ui.description: Login-gated multi-user AI agent — streaming markdown chat, per-user memory + saved sessions + audit trail, sandboxed tools (shell, web fetch, reminders, SSH, memory), messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, webhook), and pluggable model providers (platform, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible), all as skills. Responsive on phone, tablet, and desktop.

sample_prompts: A friendly DevOps assistant that runs diagnostics over SSH and reaches me on Slack
A calm research companion that fetches the web, summarizes, and keeps a running memory
A team assistant on Telegram with per-user memory and a shared audit trail
A witty coding buddy that sets reminders and reaches me on WhatsApp
